On November 4, 2026, the Board of Directors (the “Board”) of Universal Corporation (the “Company”) increased the size of the Board to 10 members and appointed Gregory R. Friedman to serve as a new director of the Company, both effective immediately. The Board has determined that Mr. Friedman qualifies as an independent director in accordance with the New York Stock Exchange Listing Standards and the Company’s Corporate Governance Guidelines. Mr. Friedman is expected to serve as a member of the Audit Committee, the Nominating, Governance and Risk Committee and the Finance and Pension Investment Committee. Mr. Friedman’s compensation will be consistent with the compensation policies applicable to the Company’s other non-employee directors, which are described under “Director Compensation” in the Company’s proxy statement for its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders (filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on July 1, 2026). There are no arrangements or understandings between Mr. Friedman and any other person pursuant to which he was selected as a director, and there are no transactions between Mr. Friedman and the Company that would require disclosure under Item 404(a) of Regulation S-K. Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure. On November 4, 2026, the Company issued a press release regarding the appointment of Mr. Friedman. A copy of this release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K. In accordance with General Instruction B.2 of Form 8-K, the information in this Item 7.01 of this Current Report on Form 8-K, including Exhibit 99.1, shall not be deemed “filed” for the purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “Exchange Act”), or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that section, nor shall either be deemed incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act, except as shall be expressly set forth by specific references in such a filing.
